Remove Paralysis (C2 Conj): R65' Frees one target from paralysis or the effects of a Slow spell; 2, 3, or 4 targets instead get an extra save at +4, +2, or +2
Repel Vermin (C4 Abju): 10' radius bars vermin (save Will for vermin with at least 5 HD inflicts 2d6 HP) for 170 min
Repulsion (C7 Abju): 170' radius bars creatures and prevents those within it from approaching (save Will negates) for 17 rd
Resist Energy (C2 Abju): Touched gains resistance 30 to a choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic for 170 min
Resistance (C0 Abju): Touched gains +1 saves for 1 min
Restoration (C4 Conj): Dispels magical ability harm from touched and cures all temporary ability damage, restores 1 drained ability, removes fatigue or exhaustion, removes temporary negative levels, and restores 1 drained level with the minimum necessary XP
Resurrection (C7 Conj): Fully restores a target willing soul, dead up to 170 years, using a piece of its corpse; the target loses a level (level 1 targets instead lose 2 Constitution)
Righteous Might (C5 Tran): Causes self and equipment to double in size, gaining a size category, +4 Strength, +2 Constitution, a +2 enhanancement bonus to natural armor, and x8 weight, and gives DR 9/evil or DR 9/good, for 17 rd
Sanctuary (C1 Abju): Foes cannot attack touched (save Will negates) for 17 rd; target attacking ends the spell
Scrying (C5 Divi): Self sees and hears a 10' radius around the target (save Will, modified by familiarity and connection with the target, negates for 24 hr) for 17 min
Searing Light (C3 Evoc): R270' Ranged touch inflicts 5d8 HP (or 10d6 HP for undead, 5d6 HP for a construct or object)
Sending (C4 Evoc): Allows self to exchange 25-word messages with a familiar target
Shatter (C2 Evoc): R65' Breakables weighing up to 17 lb in a 5' radius shatter (save Will negates), or a target object weighing up to 170 lb suffers 10d6 HP sonic (save Fortitude half)
Shield Of Faith (C1 Abju): Gives touched a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class for 17 min
Shield Of Law (C8 Abju): 17 creatures within 20' gain a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class, +4 saves, and SR 25 vs. chaotic spells and casters, suppress mental control, and slow successful chaotic attackers (save Will negates) for 17 rd
Shield Other (C2 Abju): R65' Target gains a +1 deflection bonus to Armor Class and +1 saves, and half of any damage suffered by the target is transferred to self, for 17 hr
Silence (C2 Illu): R1080' Eliminates sound in a 20' radius (save Will for a targeted creature negates) for 17 min
Slay Living (C5 Necr): Touch kills the target (save Fortitude inflicts 3d6+17 HP)
Soul Bind (C9 Necr): R65' Imprisons the soul from a corpse dead up to 17 rd (save Will negates), preventing resurrection
Sound Burst (C2 Evoc): R65' 10' radius inflicts 1d8 HP sonic and stunned for 1 rd (save Fortitude HP only)
Speak With Dead (C3 Necr): R10' Target corpse answers 8 questions (save Will negates) asked within 17 min
Spell Immunity (C4 Abju): Gives touched immunity to 4 spells of up to 4th level that are subject to spell resistance for 170 min
Spell Resistance (C5 Abju): Gives touched SR 29 for 17 min
Spiritual Weapon (C2 Evoc): R270' Creates a force weapon (+12 attack; inflicts 1d8+5 HP force; crit same as the corresponding physical weapon) that attacks a designated foe for 17 rd; can use move actions to redirect to different targets, and the first attack on each creature is subject to SR
Status (C2 Divi): Allows monitoring the condition and position of 5 touched allies for 17 hr
Stone Shape (C3 Tran): Reshapes 27 cubic feet of stone
Storm Of Vengeance (C9 Conj): R1080' 360' radius storm deafens for 1d4x10 min (save Fortitude negates), then produces rain that inflicts 1d6 HP acid, then generates lightning bolts that inflict 10d6 HP electricity on 6 targets (save Reflex half), then creates hail that inflicts 5d6 HP bludgeoning, then obscures vision and reduces Speed by 3/4 for 6 rd; the storm also prevents ranged attacks and disrupts spellcasting (save Concentration negates; add the level of the spell to be cast to the DC)
Summon Monster I (C1 Conj): R65' Summons a 1st-level extraplanar creature that fights foes and obeys orders for 17 rd
Summon Monster II (C2 Conj): R65' Summons 1 2nd-level or 1d3 1st-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 17 rd
Summon Monster III (C3 Conj): R65' Summons 1 3rd-level, 1d3 2nd-level, or 1d4+1 1st-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 17 rd
Summon Monster IV (C4 Conj): R65' Summons 1 4th-level, 1d3 3rd-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 17 rd
Summon Monster IX (C9 Conj): R65' Summons 1 9th-level, 1d3 8th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 17 rd
Summon Monster V (C5 Conj): R65' Summons 1 5th-level, 1d3 4th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 17 rd
Summon Monster VI (C6 Conj): R65' Summons 1 6th-level, 1d3 5th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 17 rd
Summon Monster VII (C7 Conj): R65' Summons 1 7th-level, 1d3 6th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 17 rd
Summon Monster VIII (C8 Conj): R65' Summons 1 8th-level, 1d3 7th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 17 rd
Symbol Of Death (C8 Necr): R60' Rune slays creatures in a 60' radius (save Fortitude negates) when triggered, working outward from the closest creatures, for 170 min or until creatures with 150 HP total have been killed
Symbol Of Fear (C6 Necr): R60' Rune panics creatures in a 60' radius for 17 rd (save Will negates) when triggered for 170 min
Symbol Of Insanity (C8 Ench): R60' Rune inflicts permanent insanity on creatures in a 60' radius (save Will negates) when triggered for 170 min
Symbol Of Pain (C5 Necr): R60' Rune causes pain that inflicts -4 attacks and skill and ability checks for 1 hr on creatures in a 60' radius (save Fortitude negates) when triggered for 170 min
Symbol Of Persuasion (C6 Ench): R60' Rune charms creatures in a 60' radius for 17 hrs (save Will negates) when triggered for 170 min
Symbol Of Sleep (C5 Ench): R60' Rune renders creatures in a 60' radius with up to 10 HD catatonic for 3d6x10 min (save Will negates) when triggered for 170 min
Symbol Of Stunning (C7 Ench): R60' Rune stuns creatures in a 60' radius for 1d6 rd (save Will negates) when triggered for 170 min
Symbol Of Weakness (C7 Necr): R60' Rune inflicts -3d6 Strength on creatures in a 60' radius (save Fortitude negates) when triggered for 170 min
Tongues (C4 Divi): Allows touched to communicate in any language for 170 min
True Resurrection (C9 Conj): Restores life with full health, levels, and prepared spells to a willing chosen creature dead up to 170 years
True Seeing (C5 Divi): Allows touched to see through 120' darkness, illusion, and invisibility, note secret doors, and see the true forms of polymorphed items for 17 min
Undeath To Death (C6 Necr): R270' Destroys 17d4 HD of undead with up to 8 HD in a 40' radius (save Will negates), working upward from those with the fewest HD
Undetectable Alignment (C2 Abju): R65' Conceals the target's alignment from divination (save Will negates) for 24 hr
Unhallow (C5 Evoc): 40' radius around touched gives a +2 deflection bonus to Armor Class, +2 saves vs. good, suppresses mental control, prevents possession, bars contact by summoned good creatures, gives -4 to turn and +4 to rebuke undead, and evokes a chosen spell upon specified creatures for 1 year
Unholy Aura (C8 Abju): 17 creatures within 20' gain a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class, +4 saves, and SR 25 vs. good spells and casters, suppress mental control, and inflict -1d6 Strength on successful good attackers (save Fortitude negates) for 17 rd
Virtue (C0 Tran): Gives touched 1 temporary HP for 1 min
Wall Of Stone (C5 Conj): R270' Creates a 85 square foot, 4"-thick permanent stone wall (the area can be doubled by halving the thickness); each 5' section has 60 hit points and hardness 8
Water Breathing (C3 Tran): Allows touched creatures to breathe underwater for a total of 34 hrs
Water Walk (C3 Tran): Allows 17 touched creatures to walk on liquid as if it were a solid surface for 170 min
Wind Walk (C6 Tran): Allows self and 5 touched to spend 5 rd changing to and from a translucent vapor that can move 60 MPH, for 17 hr
Wind Wall (C3 Evoc): R270' Creates a 170'x85'x2' curtain of air that scatters objects, bars gasses and Small or smaller flying creatures, and deflects arrows and bolts for 17 rd
Word Of Chaos (C7 Evoc): Nonchaotic creatures within 40' with 17/16/12/7 HD are banished to their home planes for 24 hr (save Will -4 negates) and become deafened for 1d4 rd/stunned for 1 rd/confused for 1d10 min/killed
Word Of Recall (C6 Conj): Self and 5 willing touched return to a chosen sanctuary
Zone Of Truth (C2 Ench): R65' Prevents creatures in a 20' radius from lying (save Will negates) for 17 min
Magic Notes:
Spell Focus (Enchantment): +1 Spell DC (Enchantment)
Craft Staff: Can create magic staves
Spontaneous Casting (Cleric): Can cast Cure or Inflict spells in place of prepared spells
Still Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without somatic components
Widen Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 higher than normal to double its area of affect
